purpose: Stable identifier tying source, join, coverage, and rebuild evidence together.
notes: Use lane-specific prefix and date.

purpose: Human-readable source family or dataset name.
notes: Do not use vague labels like internet table.
Needed for licensing and provenance.

purpose: NWR owner or lane responsible for maintaining source receipts.
notes: Can be a lane owner, not a person.

purpose: Document where the source was obtained or where frozen raw input lives.
notes: Local paths must be stable within the packet or freeze.

example: nflreadr load_pbp; manual download; API export
notes: Scraping must be explicitly flagged and is not automatically allowed.

purpose: Record when mutable source was obtained.
notes: Display-only static docs may use publication date if no acquisition is available.

purpose: Capture source release, version, season file, or commit when available.
notes: Use NOT_AVAILABLE only when documented.

purpose: Point to frozen raw source input or evidence copy.
notes: Display-only pages may store screenshot or citation instead if approved.
Required for mutable data files.
Required when normalized data feeds downstream work.

purpose: Detect truncation, parser drift, or filter mistakes.
notes: Use zero only if source legitimately has zero rows.
Pair with schema.

purpose: Define columns, types, and field meanings.
notes: Can reference a dictionary artifact.

purpose: Record where field definitions are stored.
notes: Needed before formula/model use.
Use explicit seasons, not broad wording.
Required for weekly, injury, roster, depth, schedule, or event data.
Required if source coverage varies by position.
Needed for team context and schedule data.
Must be stable before joins.
If absent, identity risk must be flagged.

purpose: List keys used to join data.
notes: Name-only joins are not approved joins.

purpose: Describe deterministic, crosswalk, manual, or other join method.
notes: Manual/name-only review rows must be separate.
Use join audit template for evidence.
Use taxonomy in this packet.

purpose: State whether source is admitted, review-only, display-only, blocked, or unknown.
notes: Admission can be narrower than source family.
Unknown license blocks model/source-truth use.
Use leakage checklist.
No silent zero fill.
Partial coverage needs caveat.

purpose: List fields in source that must not be used.
notes: Useful when a source has mixed safe and blocked fields.

purpose: Document how to regenerate raw-to-output result.
notes: If absent, exact rebuild is blocked.

purpose: List checks that passed or are required.
example: CSV parse; row count; hash check; schema check
notes: Tests are evidence, not promotion.

example: review context only; no model use
notes: Every packet should have one.
Required for backtests, replays, and tournaments.

example: Not enough information for model use.
notes: Use direct language.
